title: चार वर्षे बी.एड्. तहको नेपाली पाठ््यांशप्रति विद्यार्थीका धारणा  Char Barshe B. Ed. Tahako Nepali Pathyamshaprati Biddhyarthiko Dharana
nepali: प्रस्तुत अनुसन्धान चार वर्षे बि.एड्. तहको नेपाली पाठ््यांशप्रति विद्यार्थीका प्रतिक्रियासँग सम्बन्धित रहेको छ । यसमा त्रिवि शिक्षाशास्त्र संकाय, अन्तर्गतका विभिन्न क्यम्पसहरूमा कार्यान्वयनमा ल्याइएको पाठ््यांशप्रति विद्यार्थीहरूका रायलाई समीक्षण गरिएको छ । वस्तुतः यसको तयारीका क्रममा परिमाणात्मक अनुसन्धान ढाँचाको अनुप्रयोग गरिएको छ । यसक्रममा सामग्रीहरूलाई सर्वेक्षणात्मक विधि तथा पुस्तकालयीय स्रोतबाट सङ्कलन गरिएको छ । विद्यार्थीका प्रतिक्रिया लिँदा निर्दिष्ट पाठ््यांशका प्रत्येक स्तम्भलाई प्रतिनिधित्व हुनेगरी प्रतिमानहरू निर्माण गरिएको छ । साथै प्रतिमानहरू उच्च, मध्य तथा निम्न के कस्तो रहेको भनी रुजुसूचीको ढाँचा तयार गरिएको छ । यसका लागि पाठ््यांश शीर्षक, परिचय, साधारण उद्देश्य, विशिष्ट उद्देश्य र पाठ््य विषय, शिक्षण प्रक्रिया, मूल्याङ्कन प्रक्रिया, सिफारिस गरिएका पाठ््यपुस्तक र सन्दर्भ पुस्तकप्रति निर्धारित ढाँचामा प्रतिक्रियाहरू लिइएको छ । पाठ््यांशप्रति विद्यार्थीका प्रतिक्रियाको समीक्षण गर्ने क्रममा केही नवीन तथ्य पत्ता लागेका छन् । वस्तुतः प्रतिक्रियित पाठ््यांशका कतिपय स्तम्भगत सूचनाहरू उपयुक्त तथा कतिपय स्तम्भगत सूचनाहरू कमजोर रहेको तथ्य प्राप्त भएको छ । प्रस्तुत अनुसन्धानबाट सम्बद्ध सरोकारवालालाई अपेक्षित सहयोग मिल्ने विश्वास लिइएको छ ।
american_english: The present research concerns student responses toward the Nepali curriculum at the four-year B.Ed. level. In this study, students' opinions regarding the curriculum implemented across various campuses under the Faculty of Education, Tribhuvan University, are reviewed. In fact, a quantitative research design was applied in the course of its preparation. In this process, materials were collected through survey methods and library sources. When gathering student responses, criteria were developed so as to represent each component of the specified curriculum. Furthermore, a checklist framework was prepared to determine whether the criteria were high, medium, or low. For this purpose, responses were collected in a prescribed format concerning the curriculum title, introduction, general objectives, specific objectives and course content, instructional process, evaluation process, and recommended textbooks and reference books. In the course of reviewing student responses to the curriculum, some new facts came to light. In fact, the finding was obtained that while some component-level details in the evaluated curriculum were appropriate, certain component-level details were weak. It is believed that this research will provide the expected assistance to concerned stakeholders.
british_english: The present research relates to students' responses concerning the Nepali syllabus at the four-year B.Ed. level. Herein, students' views on the syllabus implemented across diverse campuses under the Faculty of Education, Tribhuvan University, have been evaluated. In fact, a quantitative research design was employed during its preparation. During this procedure, materials were gathered through survey methodology and library sources. In obtaining students' responses, criteria were constructed to represent each component of the prescribed syllabus. In addition, a checklist format was prepared to assess how the criteria stood in terms of high, medium and low. To this end, responses were gathered within a designated format regarding the syllabus title, introduction, general aims, specific objectives and syllabus topics, teaching processes, assessment processes, recommended course books and reference books. While reviewing students' responses to the syllabus, certain novel facts were brought to light. Indeed, the finding was reached that whilst several component-based details in the evaluated syllabus were appropriate, several component-based details remained weak. It is trusted that the present research will afford the expected assistance to the relevant stakeholders.
australian_english: This study is concerned with student feedback on the Nepali curriculum at the four-year B.Ed. level. In it, student opinions on the curriculum rolled out across various campuses under the Faculty of Education, Tribhuvan University, have been reviewed. In fact, a quantitative research framework was used in putting it together. Along the way, materials were collected through survey methods and library sources. When gathering student feedback, criteria were set up to represent each component of the specified curriculum. As well, a checklist format was drawn up to see whether the criteria rated high, medium or low. For this, feedback was gathered in a set format on the curriculum title, introduction, general objectives, specific objectives and course topics, teaching methods, evaluation methods, and recommended textbooks and reference books. In the course of reviewing student feedback on the curriculum, some new findings came to light. In fact, the finding came out that while some component-level information in the reviewed curriculum was sound, some component-level information was weak. It is hoped that this research will provide the expected help to relevant stakeholders.
informal_english: This research is all about what students make of the Nepali syllabus in the four-year B.Ed. course. It takes a good look at students' views on the syllabus rolled out across the different campuses under the TU Faculty of Education. As a matter of fact, a quantitative research design was used right through putting it together. Along the way, stuff was collected using survey methods and library sources. When getting the students' feedback, criteria were drawn up so every single part of the set syllabus was represented. On top of that, a handy checklist was put together to see whether the criteria came out high, middling or low. For this, feedback was taken down in a set format covering the syllabus title, introduction, general aims, specific aims and course topics, teaching methods, assessment methods, and recommended textbooks and reference books. While going through the students' feedback on the syllabus, a few fresh findings came to light. In truth, it turned out that while plenty of the section-by-section information in the reviewed syllabus was grand and proper, other bits were fairly weak. Sure, it is hoped this research will be of good help to all the stakeholders concerned.
translator_notes: Strict 10-sentence structure preserved. Educational terminology (पाठ््यांश as curriculum/syllabus, स्तम्भ as component, रुजुसूची as checklist) maintained across varieties.
